chunks.arabic_text: رِجَالُ الْكَشِّيِّ: وَقَالَ الْمَحْمُودِيُّ: قَدْ كَتَبَ إِلَيَّ الْمَاضِي عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ بَعْدَ وَفَاةِ أَبِي: قَدْ مَضَى أَبُوكَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ وَعَنْكَ، وَهُوَ عِنْدَنَا عَلَى حَالَةٍ مَحْمُودَةٍ، وَلَنْ تَبْعَدَ مِنْ تِلْكَ الْحَالِ

translations.en: Rijal al-Kashshi: and al-Mahmudi said: the past one (peace be upon him) wrote to me after the death of my father: your father has passed away – may Allah be pleased with him and with you – and he has with us a praiseworthy position, and you are not far-off from that position.

en.summary: This narration from Al-Kashi’s Rijal highlights the spiritual continuity between the Imams, specifically noting Imam al-Jawad’s correspondence with Ahmad b. Hammad al-Marwazi after the passing of his father, Imam al-Husayn. It underscores the Shia belief in the favorable, enduring state of the deceased Imams and their close companions, affirming that the faithful are not distant from this blessed proximity.
en.seo_question: What did Imam al-Jawad write about the status of al-Mahmudi's father after his death?

key_terms.الْمَاضِي: The deceased one (referring to the recently deceased father)
key_terms.رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ وَعَنْكَ: May Allah be pleased with him and with you (a formula of blessing)
